scope: Proposed additional six-month companionship match for an LGBTQ older adult; not housing construction, rent assistance or all intergenerational services.

judgments.label: Cash cost per new match
judgments.basis: Assumed $1,000: ten staff hours at a $60 loaded hourly cost plus $400 screening, training, transport and administration. Not an Openhouse quote. Volunteer time is an additional in-kind resource, not free societal capacity.

judgments.label: Incremental health utility while engaged
judgments.basis: Subjective .01 utility gain, not a measured Openhouse effect. External befriending evidence supports investigating depression/loneliness, but neither those scales nor local satisfaction scores are converted numerically into QALYs.

judgments.label: Effective benefit duration
judgments.basis: Half a year at the assumed effect in the central scenario; unfavorable .25 equivalent years allows later onset or fading. No lifetime extrapolation.

judgments.label: Sustained effective engagement
judgments.basis: 75% analyst assumption for proposed matches sustaining useful contact, not a completion rate inferred from 80 active pairs or incomplete local follow-up.

judgments.label: Added funding capacity
judgments.basis: 50% judgment for new effective matches versus replacement funding. Marginal capacity and actual funding room are unverified.

nullBoundary: Zero added contact, zero health improvement or fully replacement funding means no finite positive-benefit price. Signed negative utility retains possible harm. The positive scenarios are stress cases, not confidence intervals.

fundingRoom.nextEvidence: A priced marginal-match plan, volunteer/staff capacity, retention and comparative preference-based health measurement.

excluded: Loneliness and satisfaction points directly relabeled as QALYs
